evidence.reason: The member enumeration derives both include and exclude from one combined `patterns` array populated from package.json workspaces and pnpm-workspace.yaml. An exclusion declared only in package.json, such as `!packages/cli`, therefore also removes `packages/cli/package.json` from a pnpm workspace member set even though pnpm ignores package.json workspaces. That member manifest is never compared, so dependency changes there can pass validation. Scope each declaration's exclusions separately or enumerate only the workspace definition used to prepare the installed tree.
